intro: Bink is a gnome mage trainer who resides within the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. Quick-witted and enthusiastic, she guides aspiring spellcasters through the intricacies of the arcane arts and connects them with prominent wizards across the Alliance.

sections.t: A Beacon in the Hall of Mysteries
p: Located in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge, Bink stands among the gathered scholars, priests, and arcanists in the Hall of Mysteries. Like many gnomes driven from Gnomeregan, she has adapted to life within the dwarven mountain stronghold, offering her keen intellect and knowledge of arcane craft to those learning the path of the mage. She is well connected to wizards across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor, regularly pointing promising apprentices toward greater mentors such as High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind or Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
